report_text: Dengue cases increased after heavy rainfall and mosquito breeding was observed in several areas.

report_text: Rainfall created stagnant water locations and mosquito breeding risk increased.
Dengue awareness programs were conducted to reduce outbreak risk.
Several fever cases were reported, and dengue risk remains high due to rainfall and humidity.
Mosquito breeding places were found near stagnant water after rainfall.
Dengue outbreak risk is moderate, but fever and mosquito complaints are increasing.
